name: Rosewood Mandarina
insider_take: A pristine clifftop sanctuary where the Sierra Madre mountains plunge dramatically into the Pacific, offering Mexico's most exclusive beach escape.
whats_special: Perched on a 2,300-acre private peninsula, this ultra-luxe resort features treehouses suspended 60 feet above the jungle canopy and beachfront villas with infinity pools that seem to merge with the ocean. The property sits on one of Mexico's last undeveloped coastlines, where jaguars still roam and sea turtles nest on pristine beaches.
pro_tip: Book the Canopy TreeHouse for sunrise – you'll wake up at eye level with howler monkeys and tropical birds, with unobstructed Pacific views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach club accessible only by funicular, and the signature spa treatment using indigenous Huichol healing rituals. Adventure seekers should explore the property's cenotes and waterfall rappelling, while the on-site turtle sanctuary offers magical nighttime nesting experiences (seasonal).
pros: Stunning clifftop location with dramatic Pacific Ocean views
Ultra-luxurious villas with private pools and expansive terraces
World-class Asaya wellness spa with holistic treatments
Multiple exceptional dining venues including Casa Madera
Pristine private beach club with exclusive access
cons: Remote clifftop location requires resort transportation
